title: Rockstar Explains GTA 6 Satire Approach in New Interview
description: GTA6 Hub covers the latest Eurogamer interview with Rockstar, discussing the unique creative approach to satire and real-world topics in GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Evolution of Satire in GTA 6

In a recent interview covered by Eurogamer, Rockstar has discussed its revered approach to crafting the satire that the Grand Theft Auto series is famous for. The conversation specifically touched upon GTA 6 and whether the highly anticipated game should include, and lampoon, real-world politics.

## Pushing Boundaries to the Extreme

According to the insights shared, Rockstar's philosophy for the upcoming title revolves around the idea that the content "has to be more over the top, more insane, more in your face." As the real world continues to experience increasingly bizarre events, capturing and mocking modern society requires an even bolder touch. While specific details were minimal in the initial report, this design direction suggests that players can expect an exceptionally unfiltered and exaggerated portrayal of contemporary culture in GTA 6.

## Editor's Take
Rockstar has always excelled at using dark humor to dissect modern life. By promising an even more intense and unhinged approach to satire, GTA 6 is shaping up to deliver a deeply memorable cultural commentary that pushes every boundary imaginable.
